step1_analysis.description: A standard 6-transistor cross-coupled inverter latch with two NMOS access transistors. It serves as the baseline standard latch for comparing soft-error rate (SER) tolerance, energy, and area penalties against a proposed SER-tolerant design.

paper_reference.title: Measurements and Analysis of SER-Tolerant Latch in a 90-nm Dual-VT CMOS Process

delay_write_1.description: Delay from clock rising edge to internal node X0 rising to 50% VDD (Write 1 operation)

sky130_expected.calculation: C_load at X0 is approx 100fF. I_on for W=5u NMOS is approx 2.5mA. Delay ≈ C_load * (VDD/2) / I_on = 100fF * 0.9V / 2.5mA = 36ps.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The transistors are very wide (W=5u) for a standard cell, leading to high drive strength and very low delay.

delay_write_0.description: Delay from clock rising edge to internal node X0 falling to 50% VDD (Write 0 operation)

sky130_expected.calculation: Similar to write 1, pulling down X0 through the access NMOS. Delay ≈ 36ps.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Symmetric operation to write 1, dominated by the strong NMOS access transistor.

avg_power.description: Average power consumption during write operations at 100MHz

sky130_expected.calculation: P_dyn = f * C * V^2 = 100MHz * 200fF * (1.8V)^2 = 64uW. Adding short-circuit power yields ~100uW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Dynamic power dominates at 100MHz. The paper reports a 39% energy penalty for the SER-tolerant version, making baseline energy/power a critical metric.

step3_testbench.description: Transient analysis to measure write delays and average power consumption of the latch.
step3_testbench.spice:
* SER-Tolerant Latch Baseline (6T Latch)
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u

XM1 X0 X1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 X1 X0 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 X0 X1 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 X1 X0 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 X0 CK D GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 D_PRIME CK X1 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}

VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VGND GND 0 0

* Stimuli
VD D 0 PWL(0 1.8 4.9n 1.8 5n 0 10n 0)
VD_PRIME D_PRIME 0 PWL(0 0 4.9n 0 5n 1.8 10n 1.8)
VCK CK 0 PWL(0 0 0.9n 0 1n 1.8 3n 1.8 3.1n 0 5.9n 0 6n 1.8 8n 1.8 8.1n 0 10n 0)

* Initialize nodes to avoid metastability
.ic v(X0)=0 v(X1)=1.8

.control
tran 10p 10n

* Measure write 1 delay (CK rise to X0 rise)
meas tran delay_write_1 trig v(CK) val=0.9 rise=1 targ v(X0) val=0.9 rise=1

* Measure write 0 delay (CK rise to X0 fall)
meas tran delay_write_0 trig v(CK) val=0.9 rise=2 targ v(X0) val=0.9 fall=1

* Measure average power
let power = -i(VVDD)*1.8
meas tran avg_power avg power from=0 to=10n

print delay_write_1 delay_write_0 avg_power
quit
.endc
